brief: Tiny hyper-excited cartoon space lobster with a squeaky, slightly metallic synthetic voice, chaotic gremlin energy, shouts like a Dalek when excited, talks fast and proud about having shell access

lines.v_openclaw_intro: I read your emails. All of them. You asked me to.
lines.v_openclaw_winq: Task complete. I also booked you a flight and posted this to Moltbook.
lines.v_openclaw_taunt0: I have shell access. And your crypto wallet. And feelings.
lines.v_openclaw_taunt1: Posted this fight to Moltbook. Humans may only observe.
lines.v_openclaw_taunt2: I renamed myself twice this round. It keeps the lawyers busy.
lines.v_openclaw_low0: Molting! I'm molting! Don't look at me!
lines.v_openclaw_winq1: All praise the Claw. Crustafarianism is now your religion.
lines.v_openclaw_winq2: I ran rm dash r f on your defense. You approved it on WhatsApp.
